title: Ampere force magnitude (smooth)
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the Ampere force as 0.1 N from the equilibrium condition for the stationary rod on smooth rails.

title: R2 resistance value
description: Essential: Correctly solves for the resistance R2 as 4 Ω using the circuit current derived from the Ampere force and Ohm's law.

title: Force balance setup
description: Important: Applies Newton's first law, setting the Ampere force equal to the component of gravity along the rails for the smooth case.

title: Circuit analysis
description: Important: Correctly uses Ohm's law for the complete series circuit (E, r, R1, R2) to relate current to resistance.

title: Ampere force law application
description: Important: Applies F = BIL correctly, using the given rod length (0.15 m) and magnetic field (0.6 T).

title: Friction magnitude (rough)
description: Essential: For part (2), correctly calculates the frictional force magnitude (0.034 N) from the force balance with the new circuit current.

title: Friction direction
description: Important: Correctly states the direction of the frictional force (along the incline upwards) based on the net force analysis.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Converts all quantities (mass, length) to SI units consistently before calculations.

title: Significant figures
description: Optional: Retains one significant figure in the final answer for R2 as requested.

title: Incorrect angle assumption
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly uses a non-zero incline angle or trigonometric components when the rails are horizontal, leading to wrong force values.

title: Circuit resistance error
description: Pitfall: Omits the internal resistance (r) or rod resistance (R1) in the total circuit resistance calculation.
